field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. Retro reads already-completed artifacts — it is always terminal regardless of milestone outcome. Starts with 'complete:' by discipline.
field_principles.schema: carnot.operational_retro.v67 — the versioned schema that downstream tooling (conductor reconciler, doc Haiku pass) reads to validate retro artifacts.
field_principles.n_experiments_completed: Completion rate denominator for milestone health tracking. Distinguishes terminal complete: from honestly blocked and missing-no-artifact cases.
field_principles.best_244_auroc: Carry-forward of headline AUROC for trend tracking across milestones. Adversarially verified; changes only when a new ensemble run produces a verified headline.
field_principles.phase4_final_status: Terminal Phase 4 determination — the arXiv gating signal. 'blocked_precondition' means the retire_if_same_verdict trip-wire is dormant (exp2532 never ran), not triggered.
field_principles.arxiv_ready: Conjunction of all four arxiv_gates. False because gate_3 (phase4_validated_any) is False despite all mechanical submission-package blockers being resolved.
field_principles.operator_recommendation: Concrete operator action. 'request_operator_decision' surfaces the choice between option (a) implement+run, (b) accept negative and document, or (c) retire Phase 4 from this paper.
